items.title: Diagnosing Rendering & Indexing Issues with the URL Inspection API
items.summary: BrightonSEO - October 2026-When JavaScript frameworks, dynamic rendering, and headless CMS setups collide, diagnosing what Google and LLMs actually see can feel like guesswork.This talk explores how to turn Google Search Console’s URL Inspection API into a powerful diagnostic tool - automating checks that reveal hidden rendering and indexing issues long before they impact rankings.
